$comment: Offered as checkboxes during onboarding (C27 form builder) and stored against the member. `avoidPatterns` lets plan generation automatically skip contraindicated movement patterns.
disclaimer: This is programming guidance for a fitness app, NOT medical advice. Anyone with pain, a recent injury or a medical diagnosis should be cleared by a clinician before training. The app must surface this wording wherever these are selected.

items.label: Lower back pain or sensitivity
items.note: Often tolerates loaded carries and supported hinge variants; avoid heavy spinal loading until assessed.

items.label: Disc injury (current or past)
items.note: Requires clinical clearance. Avoid loaded spinal flexion and rotation.

items.label: Neck pain
items.note: Overhead loading and neck-flexed core work often aggravate.

items.label: Shoulder impingement
items.note: Prefer neutral-grip and landmine pressing; build scapular control.

items.label: Rotator cuff injury
items.note: Requires clinical clearance before loaded overhead work.

items.label: Tennis or golfer's elbow
items.note: Reduce gripping volume; isometrics are usually better tolerated.

items.label: Wrist pain
items.note: Use dumbbells or push-up handles to keep the wrist neutral.

items.label: Knee pain
items.note: Often tolerates reduced depth and posterior-chain work.

items.label: ACL injury or reconstruction
items.note: Requires clinical clearance; return to jumping is staged.

items.label: Hip impingement
items.note: Limit depth and wide stances; find the pain-free range.

items.label: Ankle instability
items.note: Build single-leg balance before impact work.

items.label: Plantar fasciitis
items.note: Reduce impact volume; low-impact cardio instead of running.

items.label: Pregnant or postpartum
items.note: Requires clinical guidance. Avoid supine work later in pregnancy and heavy intra-abdominal pressure.

items.label: High blood pressure
items.note: Requires clinical clearance. Avoid breath-holding and maximal isometrics.

items.label: Asthma
items.note: Longer warm-up; keep reliever inhaler accessible.

items.label: Diabetes
items.note: Requires clinical guidance around fuelling and glucose monitoring.

items.label: Recent surgery
items.note: Must have written clearance before any programme is assigned.
